meta.source: 4th Autonomous Greenhouse Challenge: Dwarf Tomato Timeseries and Images (Maree et al., 4TU.ResearchData, CC BY 4.0), via the derived tables in out/dash/. Scoring rules: Maree et al. 2025, Sensors 25:4321.

rows.name: Pot sells only if this share of its fruit is red
rows.if_wrong: Earliest sellable day moves; best day moves with it.

rows.name: Red fruit counted up to
rows.source: Challenge rules, Maree et al. 2025 §3.1 and Fig. 3 (verified)
rows.if_wrong: A higher cap rewards waiting longer; best day would move later.

rows.name: Price per pot at full value
rows.source: Challenge price chart, Maree et al. 2025 Fig. 3 (verified; EUR 2.00 if fruit dry matter is 8 % or more)
rows.if_wrong: Profit level changes; best day barely moves.

rows.name: Plant cost
rows.if_wrong: Profit level shifts by the same amount per pot; best day does not move.

rows.name: Re-spacing cost
rows.unit: EUR per m2 per year, per step
rows.if_wrong: Spacing is done before harvest decisions, so profit level changes but best day barely moves.

rows.name: Room area
rows.if_wrong: Only euro totals per room change.

rows.name: Base temperature for warmth (degree-days)
rows.source: Common tomato convention; matches the team's derived tables
rows.if_wrong: Ripening speed per warm day shifts; the what-if slider is most affected.

rows.name: Plant-to-plant spread in ripeness (fallback)
rows.source: 5 Nov hand weighings, 6 plants per room (dataset). From 5 Nov each room uses the spread fitted on the other five rooms' weighings up to today; this value only before then
rows.if_wrong: Wider spread delays the day 95% of pots are sellable.

rows.name: Future warmth and cost per day
rows.source: Team choice (mean of the last 7 days)
rows.if_wrong: A cold or warm spell ahead moves the best day by a day or two.

rows.name: Earliest sellable day needs this share of pots sellable
rows.if_wrong: A lower bar shows an earlier date.

rows.name: Optimal harvest zone covers days with profit at least
rows.unit: share of the best day's profit per m2 per day
rows.source: Team choice, approved by the user (D16)
rows.if_wrong: A lower share widens the zone (more days look fine); a higher share narrows it toward the single best day.

rows.name: Fruit counts as finished growing at
rows.source: Team choice; growth curve fitted on the crop weighings
rows.if_wrong: A higher share moves the earliest pluck day later.

rows.name: Fruit-weight curve steepness (fallback)
rows.source: Fitted on all six rooms' weighings (this season); used only until three weighings exist (before 5 Nov), after which each room's steepness is fitted on the other five rooms' weighings up to today. In production, the grower's previous crop
rows.if_wrong: A flatter curve finishes growing later, so the pluck day moves later.

rows.name: Truck temperature
rows.source: Common practice for partly ripe tomato (12-15 °C); not from the dataset
rows.if_wrong: A warmer truck ripens pots on the road; they arrive riper with fewer shelf days.

rows.name: Shop temperature
rows.source: Typical retail room temperature; not from the dataset
rows.if_wrong: A warmer shop shortens the days in best condition.

rows.name: Driving per day
rows.if_wrong: Two drivers halve the days on the road for far destinations.

rows.name: Pots come off the shelf at
rows.source: Team assumption, general post-harvest practice (best condition is taken as 70-90 % red)
rows.if_wrong: Shifts the sell-by date and the ship-by day.
